SHARED-F-2-S60.title: Core Consent Tier Enforcement Logic
SHARED-F-2-S60.description: Implement core business logic in ConsentService to enforce two-tier consent rules, including gating of identifiable data storage, tier transitions, and default safe handling when consent is absent.

SHARED-F-2-S61.title: Consent Validation and De-identification Enforcement
SHARED-F-2-S61.description: Integrate Pydantic validation and de-identification safeguards to ensure all data written without Tier 2 consent is anonymized per HIPAA Safe Harbor before persistence.

SHARED-F-2-S62.title: Consent Framework Unit and Integration Tests
SHARED-F-2-S62.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating consent tier transitions, enforcement behavior, API responses, and integration with lead capture and unknown question flows.
